resources.string: OCR MCQ Solver Assistant: Reads quiz questions on screen and optionally taps selected options when enabled by you.
Read & Solve Questions Right on Your Screen
Open any quiz, study guide, or PDF. Tap the floating pill anytime to read the question and see the best answer instantly.
Grant permissions once so the floating answer pill can work smoothly.
Lets the compact answer pill stay visible over your quiz app.
Reads screen text instantly without screenshots and enables optional auto-tap.
Requested automatically when you tap Start so image-based questions also work.
Pick how you want the floating helper to behave.
Choose the best way to read text from your screen.
Fastest — reads text directly from apps with zero screenshots.
Captures the screen image — best for scanned PDFs, photos, and locked pages.
If Instant Screen Reader finds no text, automatically scan the screen image instead.
Test how the solver reads a multiple-choice question and highlights the right option before using the floating bar.
Or type / paste your own multiple-choice question...
Control how quickly new questions are detected when hands-free mode is on.
Notices as soon as you move to a new question and checks within a second.
Copies each scanned question so you can paste it elsewhere. Keep off to avoid system clipboard popups.
Customize how the answer helper looks on top of other apps.
Neat frosted white pill centered near the top of your screen.
Compact floating circle you can drag anywhere along the screen edge.
Shows only A, B, C, or D inside the small pill.
Opens a resizable white glass window showing the full Gemini conversation.
Optional helper that taps the solved option for you (requires Screen Text Helper).
Automatically taps option A, B, C, or D on screen once solved.
Finds and taps Next or Continue after selecting the answer (never taps Finish Exam).
Adds a realistic 0.4s reading pause and natural finger touch position.
Feel the answer without looking or blend the pill into a battery badge.
1 short buzz = A • 2 buzzes = B • 3 buzzes = C • 4 buzzes = D
Displays answers as battery levels: 91% = A, 92% = B, 93% = C, 94% = D.
Receive live answer vibrations from your laptop browser extension over Wi-Fi.
Sign in once with your Google account to solve questions using Gemini Web with no API key needed.
Use an API key from AI Studio Secrets or paste one below for instant sub-second answers.
Fastest everyday model — great for standard quizzes and study questions.
Deeper step-by-step reasoning for complex math, physics, and coding.
Ultra-lightweight and data-saving for rapid text questions.
Questions you solve in Practice or on screen will appear here.
